fragment_alignment_policy: Reported line spans are authoritative. Stored code fragments are best-effort diagnostics and do not affect phase acceptance.
fragment_normalization: Decode as UTF-8 when valid, otherwise Windows-1252 as specified by the detector's TextDecoder('latin1'); trim outer whitespace, then replace each whitespace run with one ASCII space. A stored fragment passes when it equals or is contained in the inclusive reported source span after normalization.
source_frame: Deduplicated files selected by the detector's **/*.java discovery and exact path/content filters at commit cf82fe56acb728f076df67279ff4a78a138996f3. Hidden paths and symbolic-link traversal are excluded.
